concepts.gloss_en: 'Mah' (what) — mystical aspect of humility/nullification; Torah as the aspect of Mah

members.note: aspect of 'Mah' from the verse 'what are the testimonies', denoting middot/humility

concepts.gloss_en: Beast/animal — the aspect of the imaginative faculty (koach ha-medameh), contrasted with adam

members.note: literal beast, corresponds to body/nefesh and imaginative faculty; wholly distinct referent

notes: These forms share the letters מה only as a mechanical substring artifact; בהמה (beast) and מה ('Mah'/what) are unrelated concepts. No merge.
